generative-exploration.note: Artwork fetches https://api.ipify.org?format=json and derives its pattern from the VIEWER's IP address: blank without network, and an archive of declared libraries cannot supply it (runtime API response, different for every viewer). The 'on-chain' piece is a function of an external service.

zero-mathcastles.note: By design near-invisible: strokes animate between #151515/#151415 on a #161616/#151514 background (1/255 contrast). Excluded from verdict counts; no external requests in any condition.

chain-runners.note: tokenURI() returns https://api.chainrunners.xyz/... (HTTP 200 today). The on-chain renderer (onChainTokenURI) is read here; marketplaces that follow tokenURI see the API.

blitmap.note: tokenURI() returns https://api.blitmap.com/v1/metadata/{id}: http-5xx on two ids on 2026-10-21 (reproduced twice). The art itself is on chain (tokenSvgDataOf).

avastars.note: tokenURI() returns https://avastars.io/metadata/{id} (HTTP 200 today); renderAvastar() draws the SVG on chain.

chainfaces.note: tokenURI() returns https://chainfacesrinkeby.azurewebsites.net/api/HttpTrigger?id= (a Rinkeby-testnet-named Azure app; HTTP 200 today); getFace() draws the face on chain.

terraforms.note: tokenURI.animation_url is https://tokens.mathcastles.xyz/terraform (HTTP 200 today); tokenHTML() on chain is the self-contained animated artwork.
